mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which together predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105.0) signals strong manufacturing output expansion that drives corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating inflation that triggers central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates rapidly strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS above 440,000 million dollars) indicates strong consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth and profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 440,000, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
